title: 第七章 没别的就是想借爷的道儿第章 这一顿吃给全院看
slug: 民国戏子请叫我武道宗师
content_zh:
北平的冬夜，黑得像口倒扣的大锅。
一出德云茶园，那股子喧嚣的热浪就被北风吹了个干净。
路灯昏黄，拉长了陆诚的影子。
他怀里揣着那是救命的丹药，腰里缠着那是沉甸甸的现大洋。
这钱，烫手。
陆诚紧了紧那件满是补丁的棉袄，脚步没停，却刻意拐进了一条背人的窄胡同。
他现在的听力，那是“虎听”。
得了那“虎豹雷音”后，刚一上手便觉五脏六腑贯通一气，登时耳聪目明，五感一清。
身后三十步，那踩雪的“咯吱”声，虽然轻，但杂。
不是一个人。
起码三个。
这年头，北平城里饿急眼的狼多。
陆诚今儿个在台上又是赏钱又是金镯子，早就被人盯上了。
“朋友，跟了一路了，出来亮个相吧。”
走到胡同深处，死胡同，没路了。
陆诚停下脚步，也没回头，只是伸手拍了拍落满雪肩头。
“嘿，这小子倒是机灵。”
阴影里，钻出来三个裹着黑大褂的汉子。
领头的脸上横着一道疤，手里把玩着一把短匕首，在月光下泛着寒光。
这人陆诚认识，南城这一片有名的“溜门贼”，外号“疤脸赵”。

平时也就是偷鸡摸狗，今儿看来是想干票大的。
“陆老板，今儿个戏唱得绝啊。”
疤脸赵嘿嘿一笑，露出一口大黄牙，那笑声在死胡同里听着瘆人。
“哥几个手头紧，听说金爷赏了您不少。咱们也不多要，把那金镯子留下，大洋分一半，您走您的阳关道。”
另外两个汉子，手里拎着闷棍，一左一右包抄过来，堵住了退路。
陆诚没慌，反而转过身，饶有兴致地看着几人。
“疤脸赵，你们是吃了熊心豹子胆了？”
“这钱是金爷赏的。在天桥这一亩三分地，动了金爷捧的角儿，你们就不怕金爷把你们皮扒了，点天灯？”
陆诚这话不是吓唬人，金爷那是这一片的土皇帝，说话比巡警局都好使。
谁知疤脸赵听了，不仅没怕，反而往地上啐了一口浓痰。
“呸！金爷？”
疤脸赵眼神里透着股亡命徒的狠劲儿。
“要是以前，借爷三个胆儿也不敢。但这可是一百多块现大洋，还有金货！”
“有了这笔钱，哥几个连夜就坐火车去上海，去天津卫。天高皇帝远，他金胖子手再长，还能伸出北平城？”
“只要今儿个把你废在这儿，谁知道是我们干的？”
这就是压。
这地界儿叫天天不应，叫地地不灵。
这帮人是铁了心要干完这一票就跑路，这是要把陆诚往死里整。
换作以前的陆诚，这就得跪下磕头，把钱财拱手送上，还得被人打断一条腿。
“想跑？”

陆诚眼神一冷。
在黑暗中，竟隐隐泛着一股子幽光，就像他刚才在台上演的那只虎。
“钱在我怀里，有本事，自己来拿。”
“妈的，敬酒不吃吃罚酒，还真当自己是大虫了，给脸不要脸。”
疤脸赵脸色一狠，“上，废了他这双招子，看他以后还怎么瞪人！”
content_en:
The winter nights in Peiping were as dark as an overturned cauldron.
As soon as we left Deyun Tea Garden, the noisy heat wave was blown away by the north wind.
The street lights were dim, lengthening Lu Cheng's shadow.
He held the life-saving elixir in his arms, and wrapped around his waist was the heavy ocean.
This money is hot.
Lu Cheng tightened his patched cotton-padded jacket, and without stopping, he deliberately turned into a narrow alley that backed away from people.
His current hearing is "tiger hearing".
After receiving the "tiger and leopard thunder sound", as soon as I started using it, I felt that my internal organs were connected with Qi, my ears and eyes were clear, and my five senses were clear.
Thirty steps behind me, the crunching sound of stepping on the snow was light but noisy.
Not alone.
At least three.
These days, there are many hungry and anxious wolves in Beiping City.
Lu Cheng was on stage today and was being rewarded with money and gold bracelets, so he had been targeted for a long time.
"Friend, I've been following you all this way, come out and show your face."
When we got deep into the alley, we reached a dead end and there was no way out.
Lu Cheng stopped and didn't look back. He just reached out and patted Luo Manxue on the shoulder.
"Hey, this guy is quite clever."
From the shadows, three men wrapped in black coats emerged.
The leader had a scar across his face, and he was playing with a short dagger in his hand, which glowed coldly in the moonlight.
Lu Cheng knew this man, a well-known "sneak thief" in Nancheng, nicknamed "Scar-faced Zhao".
Usually it's just sneaking around, but today it seems that he wants to do something big.
"Boss Lu, you performed so well today."
Scarface Zhao smiled, showing his big yellow teeth. His laughter sounded scary in the dead end.
"Brothers are short on money. I heard that Lord Jin rewarded you a lot. We don't want more, so we will keep the gold bracelet and give it half to the ocean. You can go your own way."
The other two men, carrying sap sticks in their hands, surrounded them on the left and right, blocking the retreat.
Lu Cheng did not panic, but turned around and looked at the few people with interest.
"Scarface Zhao, have you eaten the courage of a bear's heart and a leopard's courage?"
"This money was rewarded by Lord Jin. If you touch the corner of this three-acre land of Tianqiao, are you not afraid that Lord Jin will peel off your skin and light up the sky lanterns?"
Lu Cheng's words were not meant to scare people. Jin Ye was the local emperor in this area and could speak better than the patrol station.
Unexpectedly, after Scarface Zhao heard this, not only was he not afraid, but he spat on the ground.
"Bah! Mr. Jin?"
Scarface Zhao's eyes showed the fierceness of a desperado.
"In the past, I wouldn't have dared to do so. But this is more than a hundred yuan, and there is gold!"
"With this money, my brothers and I took a train to Shanghai and Tianjin Wei overnight. The sky is high and the emperor is far away. No matter how long his golden fat man's hands are, can he still reach out to Peking City?"
"As long as I leave you here today, who knows it was us?"
This is pressure.
This world is called heaven and earth, and the earth and earth are not functioning properly.
This group of people was determined to run away after finishing this operation. They wanted to punish Lu Cheng to death.
If it were Lu Cheng in the past, he would have to kneel down and kowtow, hand over the money, and have one of his legs broken.
"Want to run?"
Lu Cheng's eyes turned cold.
In the darkness, there was a faint light, just like the tiger he just performed on stage.
"The money is in my arms. If you have the ability, you can take it yourself."
"Damn it, if you don't eat the toast and get a fine drink, you really think you're a big bug and you're so shameless."
Scar-faced Zhao's face turned stern, "Come on, destroy his tricks and see how he can glare at people in the future!"
